summary: ansible-core breaking changes in Ansible 11: SSH commands to Windows are no longer wrapped in powershell.exe, so raw uses the sshd default shell without guaranteed UTF-8. Use win_command, win_shell or win_powershell, or wrap raw yourself. ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH no longer has any effect.
questions: How do I make raw commands on Windows SSH hosts use PowerShell again?
Why did my raw command output encoding change on Windows?

answer_card.title: Windows SSH raw change in ansible-core 2.18
answer_card.answer_md:
Commands sent over SSH to Windows are no longer wrapped in `powershell.exe`. Only `raw` is really affected: it now runs in the default shell configured for Windows sshd, and UTF-8 output isn't guaranteed. Use `ansible.windows.win_command`, `win_shell` or `win_powershell`, or wrap the raw command yourself to set the console encoding.

Also, `ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH` no longer has any effect.
